description: Windows DNS Server, with PowerShell: on the server itself, or over SSH.

address.description: The server over SSH. Empty: ipv6ddns runs on it.

host_key.description: The fingerprint of the host's SSH key, any of them when it has several, SHA256:..., as ssh-keygen -l shows it. Recommended: without it, any key is accepted and the log warns with the fingerprint seen.

ttl.description: The records' TTL: 5m, 1h. Default: the zone's.
